text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on
the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heyyy! I'm Mayano Top Gun! I'm looking
forward
to flying with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I wanna become a dazzling adult! A grown-up Umamusume who makes everyone swoon!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So you better keep me in your sights,
Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
